items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: I used to play around with a boy called Frank Stokes. The old man, he's dead. That is his son.

ctx.x: I see. Well, we've got to get back to Dewey now. Yeah, I think we're about to run out. Unless Dewey wants to tell us some more of his favorite musicians.
Well, I don't know that many of them. I used to play around with a boy called Frank Stokes. The old man, he's dead. That is his son.
